nodes.long_description:
Involve XR offers unparalleled flexibility and customization without the need for code, and integrates into enterprise data and learning management systems.

The platform operates as both a multi-user synchronous training and assessment tool, and an asynchronous learning and practice platform, deployable in both training centers and directly to remote workers at home or in the field with low cost hardware, or via flat screens.
nodes.short_description: Involve XR is an open and flexible learning & assessment platform for institutions looking to deploy data-driven, enterprise-grade, immersive training and assessment across healthcare and public safety sectors.

nodes.change_log:
***New Features:***
---
•	Broken Earth Clinical Training: Added three new trauma and emergency response Learning Experiences, available in both VR and OnScreen environments.
---
•	New Patient Conditions and Equipment: Added new patient conditions, clinical animations, and equipment including splints, neck braces, gauze dressings, and adult IV cannulas.
---
•	Single Sign-On (SSO): Enterprise customers can now authenticate users through their existing identity management systems.
---
•	IV Pump: Completed full IV Pump support in both VR and OnScreen, including calculation fixes, interaction improvements, and UI enhancements.
---
•	Oxygen Administration in OnScreen: Oxygen can now be administered to patients in OnScreen environments.


***Improvements:***
---
•	Unreal Engine 5.6 Support: Updated loading screens and platform compatibility for Unreal Engine 5.6.
---
•	Cognitive3D: Improved session tracking accuracy and ASPC reporting.
---
•	Admin Portal: Improved field descriptions and administrator guidance.
---
•	Tech Art & Animation: Improved patient and NPC visuals, material transparency, animations, and patient spawn point support.
---
•	Platform Stability: Azure infrastructure updates and disaster recovery improvements.


***Bug Fixes:***
---
•	Resolved Broken Earth integration issues affecting scenarios, patient interactions, equipment behavior, and SSO authentication.
---
•	Fixed IV Pump calculation and interaction issues across VR and OnScreen.
---
•	Improved session reliability, localization consistency, tag filtering, and web portal stability.


***Technical Improvements:***
---
•	General platform stability, scalability, and performance improvements.
---
•	Backend, animation, material, and infrastructure optimizations.
---
•	Expanded automated test coverage and increased server capacity.

***Maintenance Update:***
---
•	Stability improvements and reduced loading times during VR app initialization.
---
•	General maintenance and performance optimizations.



***New Features:***
---
•	OnScreen Web via Pixel Streaming: Learners can now access OnScreen simulations directly from a browser with no installation required. Access is provided via a link, with no download or setup. This feature will be rolled out progressively based on infrastructure readiness.
---
•	Cough for All Patients: Cough is now available as a triggerable condition for all patients. It can be activated via the Instructor App or pre-configured using a stage token. Supports single and multi-cough animations across multiple patient positions, and is appropriately blocked by unconscious states and non-pulsatile rhythms.
---
•	New Non-Patient Clothing: New clothing options for Non-Patient characters have been created. Assets are complete and will be integrated in a future release.



***Improvements:***
---
•	IV Pump: VR Improvements: Improved IV Pump experience in VR, including calculation fixes, interaction stability, and UI polish. The OnScreen version will follow in Release 17.0.
---
•	Radial Menu usability improvements
---
•	EMR Tablet readability improvements in OnScreen mode
---
•	Improved session duration tracking accuracy in Cognitive3D (ASPC)



***Known Issues and Limitations:***
---
•	Instructor App: Installation process may be complex for non-technical users and takes a bit more time now.
---
•	Performance: Unreal Engine 5 is more resource-intensive on Quest 2, and in some scenarios, this may impact frame rate. Ongoing optimizations are in progress to improve performance.

***Maintenance Update:***
---
•	Quick fixes and minor improvements for sessions.



***New Features:***
---
•	Unreal Engine 5.6 Upgrade: The entire platform is now powered by Unreal Engine 5.6, delivering a major performance and stability upgrade. The migration was completed successfully, all plugins were carried over, and the platform is now running on the latest engine version.
---
•	Medication Management for OnScreen: OnScreen users can now administer medications using syringe, nebulizer, and pill methods, enhancing realism and expanding clinical training workflows.
---
•	AI Full Transcript and Conversation Logging: Super Admins can now access complete AI conversation transcripts per session, enabling deeper insight into learner interactions and AI patient responses for review and analysis.
---
•	Expanded Environment Support for OnScreen: OnScreen training now supports multiple environments, including Patient Room, Residential Care Facility Room, Hospice Room, and Home Environment.
---
•	Enhanced Stroke Symptom Support: Additional stroke symptoms have been introduced to improve scenario realism and better prepare learners for real-world clinical situations.


***Improvements:***
---
•	Patient Model Display: View virtual patients directly in the portal (no VR headset required)
---
•	Modality Column in Cohort Creation: Clearly distinguish VR and OnScreen experiences
---
•	Lock Learning Experiences: Prevent edits to finalized content
---
•	Hide Learning Experiences from Learners: Control learner visibility for staged releases
